findings.text: Repository cleanup is saved locally on main. Push main and the preserved release tag, verify the exact Vercel production commit, then retire obsolete branches. The owner requested a safe stop; see the cleanup resume handover.
The supplied 75 questions are unapproved drafts. Committee reviewers must verify wording, keys and book/official sources before approval and freeze.
Privacy contact, minors procedure, retention, media/prize criteria, patronage and specialist release approvals remain pending; see the technical gap report.
Real SMS activation requires an approved organization account/sender and a successful recorded readiness test. Verify current provider configuration through Admin before activation.
Confirm current production storage, staff allowlists/MFA, least privilege, backups and incident procedures before real registration. Historical evidence does not prove present configuration.
Desktop, tablet and mobile emulation passed, but real iPhone/Android and production recovery/capacity exercises remain separate checks.
